name: Soyuz TM-33
about: Soyuz TM-33 (2001-048A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STMI), launched 2001 Oct 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2001 Oct 23), held fixed
docked to S25544; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
